messages:
Maria Gonzales: quick sync — i'm drafting the long-term routing & isolation roadmap for product and need to lock on launch criteria + prioritization for Q3/Q4. major inputs: data residency customers, latency-sensitive customers, and Dedicated reserved capacity. thoughts?
Alex Choi: +1. we should surface 3 policy tiers (latency-priority, cost-priority, residency-compliant) and map each customer to a tier. that lets us scope isolation work incrementally.
Samir Kaur: +1. also add a fallback lane: if a tenant's primary region is out, route to a cold fallback model variant with lower perf but same legal posture. reduces outages while keeping compliance.
Jen Li: can we define concrete launch gates? e.g. "policy enforcement + telemetry", "canary migration for 10 tenants", "SLOs validated at 95th perc". i need that to talk to sales/pm.
Maria Gonzales: exactly — proposal draft: gate 1 = policy primitives + infra flags, gate 2 = telemetry (latency/cost per-tenant) + canary with <10% traffic shift, gate 3 = SLA docs + support runbook. agree?
Alex Choi: yes. add a perf budget per tier: latency-priority SLO = p95 < 120ms for short prompts, cost-priority p95 < 350ms but 40% lower cost. residency-compliant must have audit logs and KMS integration.
Samir Kaur: on the canary mechanics: recommend using routing-policy-weight and model-variant fallback. minimal config example: 
```
policy: latency-priority
weight: 0.1  # 10% traffic
fallback: variant-q4-compat
```
we can automate rollout via the console.
Maria Gonzales: good snippet. need product acceptance criteria too: test prompt suite (100 prompts per tenant), regression threshold < 2% BLEU/metric drop, cost delta <10% vs baseline for same throughput.
Jen Li: sales asks: how do we tell customers about migration windows + opt-outs? propose a 6-week opt-in pilot then 4-week migration window, with a managed rollback. can legal/ops sign off?
Alex Choi: ops: we need blackout windows and capacity reservations. engineering note: Dedicated customers must have commit-based capacity mapping to isolation lanes. otherwise we'll throttle them.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary release requested: routing-service v3.14 -> infra/canary (10 tenants). CI: passed, smoke: failed on one env, skipping full rollout.
Samir Kaur: infra-bot failing smoke - that one env is in eu-west-2 and exhibits higher tail latency. we should delay canary for the region until fix.
Maria Gonzales: ok hold. jen, i'll draft the customer-facing timeline (pilot -> canary -> opt-in -> rollout) and share by EOD. alex/samir, please list infra deps and minimal telemetry events by EOD too.
Alex Choi: filing infra checklist now: per-tenant SLO metrics, KV cache isolation marker, route-policy enforcement hook, rollback playbook. will ping when done.
Samir Kaur: adding: quota accounting per-lane, routing decision trace id, and billing delta metric.
Jen Li: thanks — i'll coordinate PM + sales messaging. also flagging two enterprise customers (anonymized) that want strict geo isolation — prioritize them for the pilot.
Maria Gonzales: noted. final ask: any objection to shipping a README + launch checklist with the gates spelled out before we start canaries? :thumbsup: if ok.
Alex Choi: :thumbsup:
Samir Kaur: :thumbsup:
Jen Li: :thumbsup:
